scriptLines: bronzeRaces derive(raceId = iif(isNull(raceId) || trim(raceId) == '' || upper(trim(raceId)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(raceId)) == 'N/A' || trim(raceId) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(raceId)),
year = iif(isNull(year) || trim(year) == '' || upper(trim(year)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(year)) == 'N/A' || trim(year) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(year)),
round = iif(isNull(round) || trim(round) == '' || upper(trim(round)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(round)) == 'N/A' || trim(round) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(round)),
circuitId = iif(isNull(circuitId) || trim(circuitId) == '' || upper(trim(circuitId)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(circuitId)) == 'N/A' || trim(circuitId) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(circuitId)),
name = iif(isNull(name) || trim(name) == '' || upper(trim(name)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(name)) == 'N/A' || trim(name) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(name)),
date = iif(isNull(date) || trim(date) == '' || upper(trim(date)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(date)) == 'N/A' || trim(date) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(date)),
time = iif(isNull(time) || trim(time) == '' || upper(trim(time)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(time)) == 'N/A' || trim(time) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(time)),

sprint_date = iif(isNull(sprint_date) || trim(sprint_date) == '' || upper(trim(sprint_date)) == 'NULL' || upper(trim(sprint_date)) == 'N/A' || trim(sprint_date) == '\\N', toString(null()), trim(sprint_date))) ~> limpiarTodo
limpiarTodo derive(race_name = iif((name == lower(name) || name == upper(name)), replace(initCap(lower(replace(name, '-', '~ '))), '~ ', '-'), name)) ~> normalizarNombre

normalizarNombre derive(race_date = case(regexMatch(date, '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'), toDate(date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), regexMatch(date, '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$'), toDate(date, 'dd/MM/yyyy'), regexMatch(date, '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{4}$'), toDate(date, 'MM-dd-yyyy'), regexMatch(date, '^[0-9]{4}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}$'), toDate(date, 'yyyy/MM/dd'), regexMatch(date, '^[0-9]{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-[0-9]{4}$'), toDate(date, 'dd-MMM-yyyy')),

sprint_date = case(regexMatch(sprint_date, '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'), toDate(sprint_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), regexMatch(sprint_date, '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$'), toDate(sprint_date, 'dd/MM/yyyy'), regexMatch(sprint_date, '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{4}$'), toDate(sprint_date, 'MM-dd-yyyy'), regexMatch(sprint_date, '^[0-9]{4}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}$'), toDate(sprint_date, 'yyyy/MM/dd'), regexMatch(sprint_date, '^[0-9]{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-[0-9]{4}$'), toDate(sprint_date, 'dd-MMM-yyyy'))) ~> convertirFechas
